data.titulo: Kusangukirwa kwa Yesu kugeza ku Bambutirwa kwa Paulo
data.contenido:
Ku musi ugira gatatu Yezu arazurwa. Kuri uwo musi abonekera abigishwa biwe incuro zitanu. Abandanya kubabonekera imisi 40. Munyuma yurira mw ijuru bamwe mu bigishwa biwe babona. Haheze imisi 10, Imana ishungururira impwemu yera ku bigishwa ba Yezu bāri barorereye i Yeruzalemu.

Mu nyuma abansi b’Imana bapfungisha intumwa, ariko umumarayika arazipfungūra. Abarwanya Imana batera amabuye umwigishwa Sitefano baramwica. Turumva ingene Yezu yatoye umwe muri abo bārwanya Imana aba umukozi wiwe nyawe, ni we yabaye intumwa Paulo. Imyaka itatu n’igice iheze kuva Yezu apfuye, Imana ituma intumwa Petero kwigisha abatari abayahudi: Koroneliyo n’abiwe.

Haheze imyaka nka 13, Paulo afata urugendo rwiwe rwa mbere aja kwigisha. Ku rwa kabiri ajana na Timoteyo. Turumva ingene Paulo na bagenziwe bābonye ibintu vyinshi binezereza, mu gukorera Imana. Munyuma Paulo atabwa mw ibohero i Roma, abohorwa haheze imyaka ibiri. Munyuma basubira kumufata baramwica. Izo nkuru zo mu GICE CA 7 zābaye mu myaka nka 32.

UWO mugore n’abo bagabo urazi abo ari bo? Ni Mariya Magadalena, umwe yakunda Yezu. Abo na bo bambaye izera ni abamarayika. Aho hantu Mariya ariko ararunguruka ni aho bāri bashize ikiziga ca Yezu. Hitwa imva. Ariko nya kiziga ntikikiriyo! Ni nde yagitwaye none? Reka turābe.

Yezu amaze gupfa, abaherezi babwira Pilato ko igihe yari akiriho, yavuze ko yozutse hashize imisi itatu. Bati shira rero abarinzi ku mva, abigishwa biwe ntibaze bibe ikiziga ciwe, hanyuma bavuge ngo yazutse!’ Pilato ababwira ko batuma abasoda kurinda imva.

Mu mutwenzi ku musi ugira gatatu kuva apfuye, umumarayika wa Yehova araza, atembagaza ikibuye cari ku mva. Ba basoda baragira ubwoba barananirwa no gutambuka. Barāvye mu mva, babona ikiziga cagiye! Umwe muri bo aja kubwira abaherezi. Urazi ico abo baherezi babi bāgize? Bahēreye abo basoda, bababwira ngo ‘muvuge ko abigishwa biwe baje mw ijoro dusinziriye baragitwara.’

Muri uwo mwanya nyene, abagore bākunda Yezu baja kuraba imva, baratangara basanze igaragara! Buno nyene abamarayika bambaye ivyera barababonekera. Bati ‘ni kuki muronderera Yezu ngaha? Yazutse. Nyaragasa mubibwire abigishwa biwe.’ Bariruka n’ingoga! Bateye mu nzira, umuntu arabahagarika. Urazi uwo ari we? Yari Yezu. Ati ‘genda mubwire abigishwa banje.’

Bababwiye ko Yezu yazutse kandi ko bamubonye, bumva bisa n’ibidashoboka. Petero na Yohani bariruka baja ku mva ngo bavyibonere, basanga iragaragara! Bavuyeyo, Mariya Magadalena asigarayo, ni ho yabona abo bamarayika.

Ikiziga ciwe Imana yarakizimanganije. Ntiyamuzuye afise wa mubiri w’inyama bīca. Yamuhaye umubiri w’impwemu nk’uw’abamarayika. Ariko kugira ngo yereke abigishwa biwe ko ari muzima, yīyambika umubiri abantu bashobora kubona, nk’uko tuza kuvyumva.Matayo 27:62-66; 28:1-15; Luka 24:1-12; Yohani 20:1-12. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

PETERO na Yohani bavuye ku mva aho ikiziga ca Yezu cari kiri, Mariya asigarayo wenyene atangura kurira. Arunama arunguruka nk’uko twabibonye ku gishushanyo c’imbere y’iki, abonayo abamarayika babiri! Bati ‘urizwa n’iki?’

Na we ati: ‘Umuhanyi wanje bamutwaye sinzi iyo bamushize.’ Arahindukira abona umugabo umwe, nya mugabo ati ‘urondera nde?’

Mariya yibajije ko ari umurimyi, kandi ko ari we yoba yatwaye Yezu. Ati ‘nimba ari wewe wamutwaye, mbwira iyo wamushize.’ Uwo mugabo yari Yezu yiyambitse umubiri Mariya atazi. Yezu amuhamagaye mw izina, Mariya aca aramenya ko ari Yezu. Ariruka abwira abigishwa ati: ‘Nābonye Umukama!’

Uwo musi nyene, abigishwa babiri bāriko baja i Emausi, umugabo umwe abasanga mu nzira. Bari bababajwe cane n’uko bīshe Yezu. Bariko baragenda, nya mugabo agenda arabasigurira ibintu vyinshi vya Bibiliya, birabahimbara. Bashitse batangura gufungura. Baca baramenya ko ari Yezu, aca arazimangana. Bariruka basubira i Yeruzalemu kubibwira intumwa.

Ahejeje kuzimangana, abonekera Petero na we. Abandi bavyumvise baranezerwa. Ba bigishwa babiri baca baja iyo intumwa ziri i Yeruzalemu, bazibwira ingene Yezu yababonekeye mu nzira. Bariko baravyigana, urazi igitangaza cahabaye?

Rāba aho ku gishushanyo, Yezu ababonekeye bari mu nzu n’aho umuryango wugaye. Ese ukuntu banezerewe! Uwo si umusi w’agahimbare? Ubu urashobora guharura incuro Yezu amaze kuboneka? Uharūye zitanu?

Intumwa Toma ntiyari kumwe na bo igihe Yezu yaboneka. Baramubwira bati: ‘Twabonye Umukama.’ Na we aca avuga ko azovyemera amwiboneye. Hashize imisi umunani basubira gukoranira mu nzu yugaye, na Toma yari kumwe na bo. Buno nyene arababonekera, Toma aca aravyemera.Yohani 20:11-29; Luka 24:13-43. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

IMISI irahera Yezu aciyereka abigishwa biwe. Umusi umwe abonwa n’abigishwa 500. Igihe yababonekera urazi ivyo yababwiye? Yababwiye ivy’ubwami bw’Imana. Imana yamutumye kw isi kwigisha ivy’ubwo bwami. N’aho amariye kuzuka yagumye avyigisha.

Uribuka ubwami bw’Imana ico ari co? Ni intwaro y’Imana vy’ukuri iri mw ijuru, Yezu na we ni we yatowe n’Imana ngo abe umwami. Nk’uko twavyize, Yezu yarerekanye ko azoba umwami w’igitangaza igihe yagaburira abashonje, igihe yakiza abarwaye azura n’abapfuye!

Igihe Yezu azoba ari umwami w’imyaka igihumbi mw ijuru, isi izomera ite? Yose izohinduka iparadizo y’akaroruhore. Indwano, ubugarariji, indwara n’urupfu ntibizoba bikiriho. Turazi ko ivyo ari ivy’ukuri kubera ko Imana yaremye isi ngo ibe iparadizo, abantu bayibemwo. Ni co gituma mu ntango yaremye itongo ry’i Edeni. Yezu na we azoshirwa abonye ko ico Imana yashatse kirangūtse.

Igihe c’uko Yezu asubira mw ijuru kirashika. Imisi 40 yayimaze yiyereka abigishwa biwe, baca baremera ko yasubiye kuba muzima. Imbere y’uko agenda, ababwira ati: ‘Muragume i Yeruzalemu gushika muronse impwemu yera.’ Impwemu yera ni inguvu z’Imana zimeze nk’umuyaga uhuhuta, zobafashije gukora ivy’Imana igomba. Munyuma ababwira ati: ‘Inkuru yanje muyijane muyishikane kure.’

Amaze kuvuga ivyo haca haba igitangaza. Atangura kuduga mw ijuru nk’uko ubibona ngaha. Hanyuma igicu kiramuhisha ntibaba bakimubona. Aja mw’ijuru, atangura kuganza abigishwa biwe ariyo ari.1 Ab’i Korinto 15:3-8; Ivyahishuriwe Yohana 21:3,4; Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 1:1-11. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

ABO bantu bari ngaha ni abigishwa ba Yezu. Bāramwumviye baguma i Yeruzalemu. Igihe bari barindiriye bose hamwe, mu nzu hatangura gusāma nk’igihuhusi. Hanyuma babona indimi z’umuriro ku mutwe w’umwe umwe. Zirābe kuri umwe umwe wese. Ivyo ni ukuvuga iki none?

Ico cari igitangaro! Yezu yasubiye mw ijuru kwa Se, aca ashungururira impwemu yera y’Imana ku bigishwa biwe. Urazi ico iyo mpwemu yatumye bakora? Bāciye batangura kuvuga indimi nyinshi.

Abantu benshi bari i Yeruzalemu bumvise nya gihuhusi kiriko gisāma, bāza kurāba ibibaye. Bamwe muri bo bari bavuye mu bindi bihugu baza ku musi mukuru w’Abisirayeli witwa Pentekoti. Abo bakavantara baratangara cane, bumvise abigishwa bariko bavuga ibitangaza Imana yakoze mu ndimi zabo kavukire!

Bati ‘barya bose si Abanyagalilaya, bishoboka bite none ko bavuga mu ndimi z’igihugu twavuyemwo?’

Petero arahaguruka kubasigurira. Akiriza ijwi ababwira ingene Yezu bāmwishe, Yehova na we akamuzura. Ati ‘ubu ari mw ijuru iburyo bw’Imana, kandi ni we yarungitse iyi mpwemu yera twaraganiwe. Ni co gituma mwabonye kandi mwumvise iki gitangaro.’

Avuze ivyo, benshi bumva barababaye kubera ivyo abantu bāgiriye Yezu. Bati ‘twokora iki none?’ Petero ababwira ati: ‘Mutegerezwa guta ingeso mbi zanyu, hanyuma mubatizwe.’ Uwo musi nyene abantu bashika 3000 barabatizwa, baba abigishwa ba Yezu.Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 2:1-47. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

RABA uyo mumarayika ariko arugurura urugi rw’ibohero. Abo babohorwa ni intumwa za Yezu. Reka turabe icatumye bapfungwa.

Hāri hashize igihe gito kuva aho impwemu yera ishungururiwe ku bigishwa ba Yezu. Umve ivyabaye: Petero na Yohani bāriko baja mu rusengero rw’i Yeruzalemu ku muhingamo. Imbere y’umuryango hari umuntu yamugaye kuva akivuka. Bāma bamuzana gusēga amahera abinjira mu rusengero. Abonye Petero na Yohani arabasēga. Izo ntumwa zāgize iki?

Zirahagarara zimuhanga amaso. Petero ati: ‘Nta mahera mfise, ariko ico mfise ndakiguha. Kw izina rya Yezu haguruka utambuke!’ Amufata ukuboko kw’iburyo, buno nyene aca yigera hejuru atangura kugenda. Abantu babibonye barumirwa, kandi baranezerwa kubera ico gitangaro.

Petero ati: ‘Iki gitangaro tugikoze kubera inguvu z’Imana yazuye Yezu.’ Bakiriko baravuga, bamwe mu bakuru b’idini barashika, bāza bashavuye kubera ko Petero na Yohani bariko babwira abantu ivy’izuka rya Yezu. Barabafata babashira mw ibohero.

Bukeye, abakuru b’idini baratororokana, bahamagaza Petero na Yohani hamwe n’umwe bākiza. Bati iki gitangaro mwagikoze ku bwa nde?’

Petero abishura ko ari kubera inguvu z’Imana yazuye Yezu. Nya baherezi babura uko babigira, kuko batāshobora guhakana ko ico gitangaro kitabaye. Baca barababuza ngo ntibaze basubire kuvuga inkuru ya Yezu, hanyuma barabarekura.

Imisi irahera bariko bavuga inkuru ya Yezu bakiza n’abarwaye. Inkuru z’ivyo bitangaro zishika kure, abantu benshi bāba mu mihana yegereye i Yeruzalemu babazanira abarwaye ngo babakize. Bituma abakuru b’idini bagira ishari, baca barabafata babashira mw ibohero, ariko ntibatevyeyo.

Mw ijoro umumarayika w’Imana yugurura ibohero nk’uko ubibona ngaha. Ati ‘ni mugende muhagarare mu rusengero, mubandanye kwigisha abantu.’ Bukeye mu gitondo, ba baherezi batuma abantu kw ibohero ngo babazane, basanga bīgīriye. Bābasanze mu rusengero bariko barigisha, babazana muri Sentare nkuru.

Bati ‘twābategetse ngo ntimuze mwigere musubira kwigisha ivya Yezu, ariko rāba i Yeruzalemu mwahujuje inyigisho zanyu.’ Intumwa ziti: ‘Dutegerezwa kwubaha Imana yo nkuru kuruta abantu.’ Baca bibandaniriza kwigisha “inkuru nziza.” Ako si akarorero keza twokurikira?Ivyakozwe n’intumwa ikigabane ca 3-5. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

UYO apfukamye ngaha ni Sitefano. Ni umwigishwa wa Yezu w’umwizigirwa. Rāba ibimushikiye! Abo bagabo bariko bamutera ibibuye. Ni kuki bamwanka gushika aho bamugirira nabi gutyo? Reka tubirabe.

Imana yari yamufashije gukora ibitangaro, abo bagabo na bo ntibabishima. Baca baramuhaririza kubera ko yigisha abantu ukuri. Imana imuha ubwenge bwinshi, arerekana ko abo bagabo bigisha ibinyoma. Birabashavuza cane baca baramufata, bahamagara abantu bo kumubeshera.

Umuherezi mukuru amubaza ati: ‘Ivyo none si ivy’ukuri?’ Mu kwishura atanga ikiganiro kiryoshe, kivuye muri Bibiliya. Mu kukirangiza avuga ingene kēra abantu babi bānka abamenyeshakazoza ba Yehova. Hanyuma ati: ‘Na mwebwe nyene mumeze nka bo. Mwishe Yezu umukozi w’Imana, kandi ntimwubashe amategeko yayo.’

Birabashavuza cane baryanya insya z’amenyo. Sitefano arangamije, ati ‘rāba Yezu ahagaze iburyo bw’Imana mw ijuru!’ Baca bapfuka amatwi, bamugwako bamukwegera inyuma y’igisagara.

Bashitseyo bambura imyitwikiro yabo, bayiha umusore umwe yitwa Sauli ngo ayibazigamire. Sauli uramuzi none? Bamwe muri bo batangura kumutera amabuye. Arapfukama nk’uko ubibona, arasenga ati: ‘Yehova, ntubahanire iki kibi bakoze.’ Yari azi ko bamwe muri bo bahenzwe n’abakuru b’idini. Aca aracikāna.

Umuntu akugiriye nabi, uca ugerageza kumwihora canke gusaba Imana ngo imugirire nabi na we? Sitefano na Yezu si ko bāgize. Bārakunda n’abansi babo. Natwe tugerageze kubigana.Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 6:8-15; 7:1-60. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

URAZI uwo aryamye hasi uwo ari we? Ni Sauli. Ibuka ko ari umwe yazigama imyitwikīro ya bamwe bātera Sitefano amabuye. Rāba uwo muco waka cane! Habaye iki?

Sitefano amaze kwicwa, Sauli aba indongozi mu guhīga abigishwa ba Yezu ngo abagirire nabi. Yava ku muhana akaja ku wundi, akabafata akabata mw ibohero. Benshi muri bo bahungira mu bindi bisagara, batangura kuhavugira “inkuru nziza.” Sauli na we aja mu bindi bisagara nyene kubarondera. Aha yariko aja i Damasiko. Ateye mu nzira, igitangaza cabaye ngiki:

Aza abona umuco uvuye mu kirere umwakiye hose. Aca agwa hasi nk’uko tubibona ngaha. Ijwi rica rivuga riti: ‘Sauli! Sauli! ni kuki uriko urangirira nabi?’ Abo vyari kumwe babona umuco bumva n’ijwi, ariko ntibumva ivyo ririko riravuga.

Sauli ati: ‘Uri nde ga Mwami?’

Nya jwi riti: ‘Ndi Yezu uriko uragirira nabi.’ Yezu yavuze ivyo kubera ko Sauli yariko agirira nabi abigishwa biwe, ni nk’uko ari we nyene yariko abigirirwa.

Sauli ati: ‘Ushaka ko nkora iki ga Mwami?’

Yezu ati: ‘Haguruka uje i Damasiko, barakubwira ico uza gukora.’ Ahagurutse yugurura amaso, biranka ko abona ikintu na kimwe. Yari yabaye impumyi! Abo vyari kumwe bamufata ukuboko bamujana i Damasiko.

Yezu abwira umwe mu bigishwa biwe bari i Damasiko ati: ‘Ananiya, haguruka uje kw ibarabara ryitwa Rigororotse. Ushitse kwa Yuda ubaze umugabo yitwa Sauli, namutoye ngo abe umukozi wanje koko.’

Ananiya aragamburuka. Amubonye amurambikako ibiganza, ati ‘Umukama yantumye kugira ngo usubire kubona, wuzure impwemu yera.’ Buno nyene ibintu bimeze nk’amagamba vyomoroka ku maso yiwe, aca asubira kubona.

Sauli ni we yakoreshejwe cane mu kwigisha abantu bo mu bihugu vyinshi. Yahavuye yitwa Paulo. Turaza kwiga vyinshi kuri we, ariko tubanze turābe ico Imana yatumye Petero gukora.Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 8:1-4; 9:1-20; 22:6-16; 26:8-20. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

UYO ahagaze aho ni intumwa Petero, abo bari inyuma yiwe na bo ni bagenzi biwe. Ni kuki none uwo mugabo amupfukamiye? Birakwiye ko amupfukamira? Urazi uwo ari we?

Ni Koroneliyo umukuru w’abasoda b’Abaroma. Ntiyari azi Petero, ariko bamubwiye ngo amutumeko, ashike i muhira iwe. Reka turābe uko vyagenze.

Abigishwa ba mbere ba Yezu bari Abayahudi, ariko Koroneliyo ntiyari we. Yarakunda Imana, yarayisaba kandi akama agirira abantu neza. Umusi umwe ku muhingamo, umumarayika aramubonekera, ati ‘wewe urahimbara Imana, igiye kwishura ugusenga kwawe. Tuma abantu baje kuzana umuntu yitwa Petero, aba i Yopa kwa Simoni hambavu y’ibahari.’

Aca arabatuma baja kumurondera. Bukeye begereje i Yopa, Petero yari mu nzu yo hejuru kwa Simoni. Imana ituma yiyumvīra ko abonye impuzu nini yururuka iva mw ijuru, irimwo ibikōko vy’ubwoko bwose. Itegeko ry’Imana ryarabuza kubirya. Ariko haza ijwi riti: ‘Haguruka Petero wice urye.’

Na we ati: ‘Oyaye! Sindigera ndya ikintu kibi.’ Nya jwi riti: ‘Ico Imana yavuze ko ari ciza reka kuvuga ngo ni kibi.’ Ivyo biba gatatu kose. Petero akiriko aribaza ico ivyo bishaka kuvuga, ba bandi batumwa na Koroneliyo barashika barondera Petero.

Arururuka, ati ‘uwo muriko murondera ni jewe. Mugenzwa n’amaki?’ Bamwiganiye ko umumarayika yabwiye Koroneliyo ngo atumeko Petero ashike iwe, aremera ko bajana. Bukeye Petero na bagenziwe baja i Kayisariya kwa Koroneliyo.

Yari yakoranije incuti n’abagenzi. Petero ashitse, aja kumusanganira. Ashika agwa hasi aramupfukamira nk’uko ubibona ngaha. Petero ati: ‘Haguruka nanje nyene ndi umuntu.’ Bibiliya yerekana ko atari vyiza gupfukamira umuntu ngo umusenge. Dutegerezwa gusenga Yehova gusa.

Petero yigisha abāri bakoranye ati: ‘Ndabonye ko Imana yemera abantu bose bashaka kuyikorera.’ Akiriko aravuga, Imana irungika impwemu yera yayo, nya bantu batangura kuvuga indimi nyinshi. Ba bigishwa b’abayahudi bari bazananye na Petero baratangara, kuko bībaza ko Imana ikunda Abayahudi gusa. Bica bibigisha ko Imana itabona ko abantu b’ubwoko kanaka ari bo beza kurusha abandi. Ivyo ntibikwiye ko twese hamwe tuvyibuka?Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 10:1-48; 11:1-18; Ivyahishuriwe Yohani 19:10. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

UYO musore ubona ari kumwe n’intumwa Paulo ni Timoteyo. Timoteyo yabana n’ab’iwabo i Lusitira. Nyina yari Ewunike, inakuru na we Lowisi.

Aha bwari ubugira gatatu Paulo ashika i Lusitira. Umwaka umwe imbere y’aho, Paulo na Barunaba bari bahaje bari ku rugendo rwabo rwa mbere rwo gukwiza hose inkuru nziza. Ico gihe Paulo yari asubiyeyo, ari kumwe na mugenziwe Sila.

Urazi ivyo Paulo yariko arabwira Timoteyo? Ngo ‘woshima kuduherekeza twe na Sila? Woshobora kudufasha gutwara inkuru nziza kure.’

Na we ati: ‘Egome nobishima.’ Timoteyo aca asiga ab’iwabo, ajana na Paulo na Sila. Imbere y’uko twiga ivy’urwo rugendo rwabo, reka tubanze tumenye ivyagiye birashikira Paulo. Kuva igihe yariko aja i Damasiko Yezu akamubonekera, imyaka ishika 17 yari imaze guhera.

Ibuka ko yari yajanyweyo n’ukugirira nabi abigishwa ba Yezu, we nyene aca aba umwigishwa! Munyuma abansi baja inama yo kumwica, kuko batāshaka uwuvuga ivya Yezu, abigishwa baramufasha arahunga. Bāmwururukije mu kivumvu ku rugo rw’igisagara.

Aca aja i Antiyokiya kwigisha. Abigishwa ba Yezu ni ho bitiwe abakirisu. Ni ho kandi Paulo na Barunaba baba, igihe batumwa gukwiza inkuru nziza mu bihugu vya kure. Bārashitse n’i Lusitira kwa ba Timoteyo.

Hashize nk’umwaka, Paulo asubira i Lusitira ubugira kabiri. Timoteyo, Paulo na Sila bavuyeyo urazi iyo baroye? Rāba kuri iyo ndondabihugu twige hamwe hamwe. Bābanje aho hafi Ikoniyo, hanyuma baja i Antiyokiya. Bahavuye baja i Tirowa, i Filipi, i Tesalonike n’i Beroya. I Atenayi urahabona? Paulo yarahigishije, bahavuye bamara umwaka n’inusu i Korinto, hanyuma bamara imisi mike i Efeso, baca burira imeri bagaruka i Kayisariya, hanyuma badūga i Antiyokiya aho Paulo yaba.

Timoteyo yaragenze ibirometero vyinshi ariko afasha Paulo gutwara “inkuru nziza” no gushinga amashengero menshi y’abakirisu. Ni wakura uzoba umukozi w’Imana w’umwizigirwa nka Timoteyo?Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 9:19-30; 11:19-26; Ikigabane ca 13-17; 18:1-22. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

YOO! Ivyo bibaye ngaha ni ibiki? Uwo muhungu arambaraye hasi hari ico yabaye? Ehe rāba Paulo ari muri abo bariko barasohoka! Timoteyo we uramubona? Uwo muhungu yakorotse ava kw idirisha?

Egome ni ho yakorotse ava. Paulo yariko arasigurira abigishwa b’i Tirowa. Yari azi ko batazosubira kubonana vuba kubera ko yazinduka yurira imeri, ni co gituma yasiguye ashikana mu gicugu.

Uwo muhungu yitwa Eyutiko yari yicaye kw idirisha, arasinzira. Ava kw igorofa ya gatatu, aca mw idirisha akorokera hasi! Ni co gituma ubona abo bantu bahagaritse imitima. Nk’uko bāvyikeka, baramuvyura basanga yapfuye!

Paulo abonye ko yamaze gupfa amurambararako aramupfumbatira, ati ‘shira imitima mu nda arabona.’ Kandi vyari vyo! Ico cari igitangaro! Paulo yari yamuzuye! Bose buzura akamwemwe.

Basubira kuduga hejuru barafungura. Paulo abandanya gusigura ashikana mu gitondo. Eyutiko ntiyasubiye gusinzira! Hanyuma Paulo na Timoteyo hamwe n’abo vyari kumwe burira imeri. Urazi iyo baciye baja? Paulo yari ahejeje urugendo rwiwe rugira gatatu, ubu yariko asubira i muhira. Muri urwo rugendo, i Efeso yari ahamaze imyaka itatu ari wenyene. Rwari rurerure kuruta urwa kabiri.

Imeri yavuye i Tirowa ihagarara i Mileto akanya gato. Kubera ko i Efeso hatari kure, Paulo atumako abazezwashengero ngo bāze i Mileto, baganire ubwa nyuma. Hageze ko imeri igenda, barababara cane kubera ko Paulo agiye!

Munyuma nya meri ishika i Kayisariya. Paulo akiri i muhira kwa Filipo umwigishwa, umumenyesha kazoza Agabo aramubūrira, ngo ni yashika i Yeruzalemu azopfungwa. Uko ni ko vyabaye. Yamaze imyaka ibiri apfungiwe i Kayisariya, hanyuma ajanwa i Roma gusamba ku mwami Kayisari. Reka turābe ivyabaye muri urwo rugendo rw’i Roma.Ivyakozwe n’intumwa ikigabane ca 19-26. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

RABA iyo meri yaguye mw isanganya iramenagurika! Urazi abo bariko barasimbira mu mazi abo ari bo? Bamwe bamaze gushika i rusi. Uyo yoba ari Paulo? Reka turabe ivyamushikiye.

Ibuka ko yamaze imyaka ibiri apfungiwe i Kayisariya. We hamwe n’abandi bapfungwa, burizwa imeri bajanwa i Roma. Barengānye izinga ryitwa Kirete, igihuhusi kibasangaho. Kirahuhuta gushika aho abadereva bananirwa kuyiyobora. Izuba ku murango n’inyenyeri mw ijoro ntivyaboneka. Hashize imisi, abari mu meri barihebūra ko batagikira.

Paulo arahaguruka, ati ‘nta n’umwe muri mwebwe aza gutakaza ubuzima, imeri gusa ni yo iza kwononekara. Muri iri joro, umumarayika w’Imana yambwiye ati: “Ntutinye Paulo! Uzohagarara imbere y’umwami Kayisari, kandi Imana izokiza abo muri kumwe mu bwato bose.” ’

Mu gicugu hashize imisi 14 kuva aho ico gihuhusi gitanguriye, abakozi bo mu meri baramenya ko ibenga ritakiri rinini! Kugira ngo ntibahave bitura ku bitandara mu mwiza, bata inanga mu mazi. Bukeye basanga bari hafi y’i rusi, baca bagerageza gutwarayo imeri.

Bahegereye, imeri yicara ku musenyi ica irafatwa, ibisebuzi (imipfunda) bitangura kuyimenagura. Umukuru w’abasoda ati: ‘Abazi kwoga bose ni mubanze musimbire mu mazi mujabuke. Abasigaye ni mubakurikire, mufatīriye ku mbaho zavuye ku meri.’ Babigira gutyo nyene, bose uko bari 276 bashika amahoro i rusi, nk’uko umumarayika yari yabibaraganiye.

Iryo zinga ryītwa Melita. Abantu baho bari beza cane, barabakīra. Ijuru rimaze gutamuruka, Paulo yinjizwa mu yindi meri ajanwa i Roma.Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 27:1-44; 28:1-14. Ibibazo bikoreshwa mu kwiga

RABA uwo munyororo kuri Paulo, rāba n’uwo musoda w’umuroma amucunze. Apfungiwe i Roma, arindiriye ko Kayisari amucira urubanza. Igihe yari apfunzwe, abantu ntibari babujijwe kuza kumurāba.

Amaze imisi itatu i Roma, atumako abayahudi bakuru ngo baze kumurāba. Benshi baraza, atangura kubigisha ivya Yezu n’ubwami bw’Imana. Bamwe barabishima baba abakirisu, abandi na bo baravyanka.

Abasoda bāmucunga na bo nyene yarabigishije. Mu myaka ibiri yamaze abohewe aho, yarigishije uwo wese amukundiye, gushika aho abo mu ngoro kwa Kayisari bumva inkuru nziza y’ubwami, bamwe muri bo baba abakirisu. Uwo mushitsi ariko yandikira ku meza ni nde? Womukekeranya? Egome ni Timoteyo. Na we nyene yari yāpfunzwe ahorwa kwigisha ivy’ubwami, ariko aho yari yapfunguwe. Yari yaje gufasha Paulo. Urazi ivyo ariko yandika none? Reka tubirābe.

Uribuka i Filipi n’i Efeso twize mu nkuru ya 110? Paulo ni we yakoze gushika aho amashengero y’abakirisu y’aho hantu ashingwa. Igihe rero yari mw ibohero, yandikira abo bakirisu amakete. Nya makete ari muri Bibiliya, yitwa Abanyefeso; Ab’i Filipi. Aho Paulo yariko abwira Timoteyo ivyo yandikira abakirisu bagenzi biwe b’i Filipi.

Ab’i Filipi bari bāmugiriye neza. Bari bāmurungikiye imfashanyo, yariko arabashimira. Epafurodito ni we yari yayimuzaniye, ariko yari yarwaye agera kure. Ico gihe yari yakize, yashaka gutaha. Ni we yahava atwara iryo kete rya Paulo na Timoteyo gushika i Filipi.

Igihe Paulo yari mw ibohero, yanditse ayandi makete abiri muri Bibiliya. Rimwe yaryandikiye abakirisu b’i Kolosayi. Urazi uko ryitwa? Ab’i Kolosayi. Irindi yaryandikiye umugenzi yakunda cane yitwa Filemoni, na we nyene yaba i Kolosayi. Ryavuga ivya Onesimo umusuku wa Filemoni.

Onesimo yari yatorotse kwa Filemoni aja i Roma, ahava aramenya ko ari ho Paulo apfungiwe aja kumurāba. Paulo aramwigisha aca aba umukirisu, yumva arababaye kubera ko yatorotse. Urazi none ivyo Paulo yandikiye Filemoni muri iryo kete?

Paulo yasavye Filemoni ngo ababarire Onesimo, ati ndamukurungikiye, ariko ubu si umusuku wawe gusa, ni mweneso, umukirisu mwiza.’ Onesimo asubiye i Kolosayi yagiye ajanye ayo makete abiri, rimwe ry’ab’i Kolosayi, irindi rya Filemoni. Iyumvīre ukuntu Filemoni yanezerewe, aho yumviye ko umusuku wiwe yabaye umukirisu.

Igihe Paulo yandikira ab’i Filipi na Filemoni, yababwiye agakuru keza. Yabwiye ab’i Filipi ati: ‘Ndabarungikiye Timoteyo, ariko nanje nyene nzoza kubarāba vuba.’ Filemoni na we amwandikira ati: ‘Urantegurira aho nzoshikira.’

Paulo apfunguwe yagendeye abakirisu benese bāba ahantu henshi. Munyuma asubira gupfungirwa i Roma. Ico gihe yari azi ko azokwicwa, aca yandikira Timoteyo ngo aze n’ingoga. Ati ‘nagumye ndi umwizigirwa ku Mana, na yo izompera.’ Hashize imyaka mikeyi Paulo yishwe, i Yeruzalemu harabomorwa, ico gihe habomorwa n’Abaroma.

Bibiliya irimwo vyinshi. Imana ibwira intumwa Yohani ngo yandike ibitabu vya nyuma, hamwe n’icitwa Ivyahishuriwe Yohani. Ico gitabu cigana ivya kazoza. Ubu reka turābe ibizoza ivyo ari vyo.Ivyakozwe n’intumwa 28:16-31; Ab’i Filipi 1:13; 2:19-30; 4:18-23; Abaheburayo 13:23; Filemoni1-25; Ab’i Kolosayi 4:7-9; 2 Timoteyo 4:7-9.
